annotations.text:
Desktop layout fix
Top row: desktop (1440px) versions of every main screen, replacing the mobile column stretched into a wide viewport with a real desktop composition — centered content, two-column layouts (checklist + sidebar, profile + stats, invite code + danger zone), and per-screen fixes from the review (destructive actions now read as dangerous, leaderboard top-3 stand out, badges show locked vs earned, the wall's member row no longer cuts off with no scroll cue).
Bottom row: mobile (390px) versions of the same screens, for side-by-side comparison — these match the app's existing mobile layout, which wasn't broken.
